intent: Individually preserve time phrases, complete subjects, conditions, places, step actions, causes and parenthetical identities. Reject mechanical word-count segmentation while keeping valid real-world variants open.
picturePurpose: Exact sentence and boundary diagrams expose broken phrases; code labels carry all linguistic evidence.

transfer.stem: 为了把完整时间从句与后面的提醒分开，哪种分组最符合本题目标？
transfer.passage:
Before you leave, check the windows.
目标：把 Before you leave 保留为完整的时间从句，再与后面的提醒分开。

options.text: Before / you leave check the windows.
Before you leave / check the windows.
Before you / leave check / the windows.
Before you leave check the / windows.

answer.display: Before you leave / check the windows.

explanation.strategy: 先用目标中的完整从句确定边界，再检查剩下的提醒。

steps.text: Before you leave 是完整时间从句。
steps.reason: Before 后面的 you leave 不能因平均字数而拆开。

steps.text: check the windows 是完整提醒。
steps.reason: 动词与宾语连贯表达检查什么。
保留两层意思，符合本题指定目标。

distractors.reason: 拆开了 Before 与它引导的从句。
既打碎时间从句，也把主句动作与宾语切开。
没有按目标分出时间从句，还拆开 the windows。

explanation.pitfall: 这是指定目标下的建议，不把其他语境中的合理停顿一概判错。

visual.title: 完整从句与完整提醒
visual.caption: 斜线帮助理解关系，不规定停顿秒数。
